Quick note from the Acme Robotics team — we finished the integration tests for Redwood today and are nearly ready to run a full 48-hour throughput evaluation next week. Our trial account expired yesterday, and the team lost access to the dedicated test dataset we loaded.

Will loop in finance/ops for the final sign-off once you confirm.
